$comment: Per-qadam exceptions to the ADR-0003 bundle (#804). Every entry carries its reason. `nodeModules`: packages left out of the bundle and shipped, with their dependency closure, in the artifact's node_modules (kind `bundle-with-node-modules`, ADR-0003's native-module exception). `optionalNative`: a detected native addon the package loads inside try/catch and works without, so the qadam stays a plain bundle. `extraEntryPoints`: source files the qadam starts by path from `__dirname` (a worker thread or forked child); each is bundled to `src/<basename>.js`, next to the bundle, where `__dirname` points.

nodeModules.tiktoken: reads tiktoken_bg.wasm from its own directory when the module loads

nodeModules.clarifai-nodejs-grpc: loads its .proto files from its own directory when the module loads

nodeModules.@duckdb/node-api: @duckdb/node-bindings requires a per-platform package's duckdb.node addon (@duckdb/node-bindings-<os>-<cpu>)

nodeModules.playwright: playwright-core reads its injected scripts and browser registry from its own directory at run time and requires chromium-bidi, which it does not declare

nodeModules.tiktoken: reads tiktoken_bg.wasm from its own directory when the module loads

nodeModules.oracledb: thick mode loads oracledb's compiled addon from its own build/Release directory

extraEntryPoints.src/lib/common/oracle-runner.ts: runner-pool.ts forks `path.join(__dirname, 'oracle-runner.js')` (upstream lost this file in its bundle: activepieces#14967 / #15957)

optionalNative.ssh2: ssh2 requires its sshcrypto addon inside try/catch and falls back to Node's crypto; cpu-features likewise

optionalNative.snowflake-sdk: its minicore addon is loaded through eval('require') inside try/catch, written for bundlers; without it the driver reports 'Binary is missing from the bundle' in telemetry and works

nodeModules.jsdom: resolves its xhr-sync-worker.js by path (require.resolve) when the module loads
